fields.definition: Total income-tax charge: current plus deferred, including prior-year adjustments. Excludes indirect taxes.

The current-tax SUBTOTAL as the filer reports it. Most filers already fold prior-year adjustments into this figure -- TCS prints 16,124 less a 1,946 prior-year benefit and reports 14,178 -- so take the subtotal, not its parts.
Tax effect of temporary differences. Often a credit (negative) when reversing.

ONLY a tax charge the filer presents SEPARATELY FROM and IN ADDITION TO its current- and deferred-tax lines, such that current + deferred + this equals the reported total tax expense. If the reported total already equals current + deferred, there is no other tax and this is a correct null.
fields.measured: On TCS this was filled with -1,566 taken from the EFFECTIVE-TAX-RATE RECONCILIATION ('Income exempt from tax'), a table that explains why expected tax differs from reported tax rather than composing it. Total tax expense then came out at 12,144 against a reported 13,710. TCS's total is exactly current 14,178 + deferred (468); nothing else belongs in it.
